# Monoline

> Open-source UI kit: a plain CSS core (@monoline/css) with accessible React components (@monoline/react). Three themes, four accents, no Tailwind, no runtime CSS-in-JS.

Start with AGENTS.md (how to work in this repo) and DESIGN.md (the look and rules). Every component is a folder with source, test, demo and meta.json.

## Accordion (accordion)
Stacked headings that each show or hide a section.
Import: import {Accordion} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Accordion | Status: stable
A11y:
- Each trigger is a button inside a heading with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
- Enter and Space toggle; Arrow keys, Home and End move between triggers.
- single or multiple open items; collapsible lets the last one close.
Files: packages/react/src/components/accordion/accordion.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/accordion/accordion.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/accordion/accordion.tsx, packages/react/src/components/accordion/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/accordion/meta.json

## Alert (alert)
A message that stays on screen, with a title and a tone.
Import: import {Alert} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- danger and warning are role=alert and announced at once; info and success are role=status and polite.
- The title always states the meaning in words; colour is not the only signal.
Files: packages/react/src/components/alert/alert.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/alert/alert.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/alert/alert.tsx, packages/react/src/components/alert/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/alert/meta.json

## Alert dialog (alert-dialog)
A modal that interrupts to confirm a destructive or irreversible action.
Import: import {AlertDialog} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/AlertDialog | Status: stable
A11y:
- role="alertdialog" with a name from the title and a description.
- Focus moves to the Cancel button on open and returns to the trigger on close.
- Escape cancels; focus is trapped; the page behind is inert.
- Clicking the overlay does not close it.
Files: packages/react/src/components/alert-dialog/alert-dialog.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/alert-dialog/alert-dialog.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/alert-dialog/alert-dialog.tsx, packages/react/src/components/alert-dialog/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/alert-dialog/meta.json

## Animated list (animated-list)
A list whose items enter one by one without shifting the layout.
Import: import {AnimatedList} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- A real <ul> with <li> items, so list semantics and counts are announced.
- Items fade in with opacity only and keep their space from the first frame; there is no layout shift.
- With prefers-reduced-motion all items are visible at once.
Files: packages/react/src/components/animated-list/animated-list.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/animated-list/animated-list.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/animated-list/animated-list.tsx, packages/react/src/components/animated-list/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/animated-list/meta.json

## Aspect ratio (aspect-ratio)
Keep media or a placeholder at a fixed width-to-height ratio.
Import: import {AspectRatio} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/AspectRatio | Status: stable
A11y:
- A plain div; the content keeps its own semantics and alt text.
Files: packages/react/src/components/aspect-ratio/aspect-ratio.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/aspect-ratio/aspect-ratio.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/aspect-ratio/aspect-ratio.tsx, packages/react/src/components/aspect-ratio/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/aspect-ratio/meta.json

## Autocomplete (autocomplete)
A text field that suggests values while you type and accepts anything you enter.
Import: import {Autocomplete} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- ARIA 1.2 combobox with aria-autocomplete="list", aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant.
- ArrowDown/ArrowUp move through suggestions, Enter picks the active one (or keeps typed text), Escape closes.
- The field value is always the typed or picked text; nothing is forced to match a suggestion.
Files: packages/react/src/components/autocomplete/autocomplete.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/autocomplete/autocomplete.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/autocomplete/autocomplete.tsx, packages/react/src/components/autocomplete/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/autocomplete/meta.json

## Avatar (avatar)
A person or thing as an image with an initials fallback.
Import: import {Avatar} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Avatar | Status: stable
A11y:
- name is required: it is the image alt text and the fallback's accessible name.
- The fallback shows while the image loads or if it fails.
Files: packages/react/src/components/avatar/avatar.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/avatar/avatar.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/avatar/avatar.tsx, packages/react/src/components/avatar/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/avatar/meta.json

A11y:
- role="group" with an accessible name; the overflow count is plain text.

## Badge (badge)
A short status word or count.
Import: import {Badge} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- Plain text in a span; the word carries the meaning, not the colour.
- For a count that changes, put it inside an aria-live region yourself.
Files: packages/react/src/components/badge/badge.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/badge/badge.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/badge/badge.tsx, packages/react/src/components/badge/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/badge/meta.json

## Bento grid (bento-grid)
A responsive asymmetric grid of cards with column and row spans.
Import: import {BentoGrid} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- Plain divs in source order, so reading and tab order match the visual order on phones and follow the DOM elsewhere.
- Spans collapse to a single column on narrow screens; nothing depends on colour or motion.
Files: packages/react/src/components/bento-grid/bento-grid.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/bento-grid/bento-grid.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/bento-grid/bento-grid.tsx, packages/react/src/components/bento-grid/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/bento-grid/meta.json

## Call to action block (block-cta)
A closing call to action with one sentence and one next step.
Import: import {BlockCta} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: beta
A11y:
- A section named by its title; actions are ordinary buttons or links.
Files: packages/react/src/components/block-cta/block-cta.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/block-cta/block-cta.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/block-cta/block-cta.tsx, packages/react/src/components/block-cta/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/block-cta/meta.json

## Dashboard shell block (block-dashboard-shell)
App frame with sidebar, top bar and content that collapses to a drawer on small screens.
Import: import {BlockDashboardShell} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: beta
A11y:
- The sidebar and the drawer hold the same navigation landmark, named by navLabel; the current page has aria-current="page".
- Below 800px the sidebar is hidden and a Menu button opens a left drawer: focus is trapped, Escape closes it and focus returns to the button.
- Choosing a link closes the drawer. The content is a main landmark; put one h1 in it.
Files: packages/react/src/components/block-dashboard-shell/block-dashboard-shell.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/block-dashboard-shell/block-dashboard-shell.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/block-dashboard-shell/block-dashboard-shell.tsx, packages/react/src/components/block-dashboard-shell/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/block-dashboard-shell/meta.json

Import: import {BlockEmptyPage} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: beta
A11y:
- A section named by its title, with the title as the page heading.

Primitive: none | Status: beta

- A section named by its title; features are a list of items.
- Feature titles are headings one level below the section title, so the outline stays in order.

## Footer block (block-footer)
A site footer with brand, link columns and small print.
Import: import {BlockFooter} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: beta
A11y:
- A footer element: the page contentinfo landmark. Use one per page.
- Each link column is a nav named by its title, with a heading at the chosen level.

## Hero block (block-hero)
A page opener with eyebrow, title, description, actions and optional media.
Import: import {BlockHero} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: beta
A11y:
- A section named by its title through aria-labelledby.
- The title is a real heading; headingLevel sets the outline level (h1 by default).
- Media is passed in: give images alt text.
Files: packages/react/src/components/block-hero/block-hero.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/block-hero/block-hero.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/block-hero/block-hero.tsx, packages/react/src/components/block-hero/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/block-hero/meta.json

## Login block (block-login)
Email and password sign-in form with validation messages.
Import: import {BlockLogin} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: beta
A11y:
- A section named by its title; the form is named by the same heading.
- Invalid submits show a role=alert summary whose links move focus to each field, and each field gets aria-invalid and an error message.
- Email and password carry autocomplete hints for password managers.
Files: packages/react/src/components/block-login/block-login.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/block-login/block-login.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/block-login/block-login.tsx, packages/react/src/components/block-login/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/block-login/meta.json

## Pricing block (block-pricing)
Plan cards with a monthly and yearly switch.
Import: import {BlockPricing} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: beta
A11y:
- A section named by its title; plans are a list, each with a heading one level below the title.
- The billing switch is a named radio group operable with arrow keys.
- Prices are plain text next to their period, never colour alone; the popular plan carries a text badge.
Files: packages/react/src/components/block-pricing/block-pricing.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/block-pricing/block-pricing.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/block-pricing/block-pricing.tsx, packages/react/src/components/block-pricing/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/block-pricing/meta.json

## Settings form block (block-settings-form)
Settings sections of switches and selects, each in a fieldset.
Import: import {BlockSettingsForm} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: beta
A11y:
- Each section is a fieldset with a legend, so grouped controls are announced with it.
- Switches have role=switch with visible labels; hints are linked with aria-describedby.
- Selects are native and labelled.

The path to the current page.
Import: import {Breadcrumb} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- A nav landmark with an aria-label, containing an ordered list.
- The current page has aria-current=page and is not a link.

## Button (button)
Triggers an action. Native button with solid, line, ghost and danger variants.
Import: import {Button} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Slot | Status: stable
A11y:
- Native <button>: Enter and Space activate, Tab focuses.
- loading sets aria-busy and blocks clicks while keeping the label.
- asChild renders a link without losing link semantics.
Files: packages/react/src/components/button/button.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/button/button.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/button/button.tsx, packages/react/src/components/button/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/button/meta.json

- role="group" with a required accessible name.

## Calendar (calendar)
A month grid for picking one date.
Import: import {Calendar} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- role="grid" with column headers; one day is in the tab order (roving tabindex).
- Arrow keys move by day and week, Home/End to the start and end of the week, PageUp/PageDown by month.
- Each day button has a full date name; the selected day has aria-pressed and today has aria-current="date".
Files: packages/react/src/components/calendar/calendar.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/calendar/calendar.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/calendar/calendar.tsx, packages/react/src/components/calendar/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/calendar/meta.json

## Card (card)
A bordered group for one thing you can pick up or open.
Import: import {Card} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Slot | Status: stable
A11y:
- Plain divs and a heading; no roles added.
- With asChild on a link or button the whole card is one keyboard-focusable control.
Files: packages/react/src/components/card/card.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/card/card.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/card/card.tsx, packages/react/src/components/card/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/card/meta.json

## Carousel (carousel)
A row of slides you scroll or step through with buttons.
Import: import {Carousel} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- A named region with aria-roledescription="carousel"; each slide is a group named "N of M".
- Previous and Next are real buttons; the track is also scrollable by keyboard and touch.
- No auto-play, so nothing moves without the user.
Files: packages/react/src/components/carousel/carousel.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/carousel/carousel.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/carousel/carousel.tsx, packages/react/src/components/carousel/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/carousel/meta.json

## Checkbox (checkbox)
A box to turn one choice on or off, with an indeterminate state.
Import: import {Checkbox} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Checkbox | Status: stable
A11y:
- role=checkbox; Space toggles; Tab focuses.
- indeterminate is exposed as aria-checked=mixed.
- A visible label is clickable; without one, aria-label is required.
Files: packages/react/src/components/checkbox/checkbox.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/checkbox/checkbox.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/checkbox/checkbox.tsx, packages/react/src/components/checkbox/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/checkbox/meta.json

- The trigger is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls.

## Color picker (color-picker)
Choose a colour from preset swatches, the native colour control, or a hex value.
Import: import {ColorPicker} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- A group with an accessible name; each swatch is a button named by its hex value, with aria-pressed for the current colour.
- The native colour input and the hex text field each have their own name.
- The hex field sets aria-invalid and points to an error message with aria-describedby until the value is valid; colour is never the only signal because the hex text is always shown.
Files: packages/react/src/components/color-picker/color-picker.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/color-picker/color-picker.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/color-picker/color-picker.tsx, packages/react/src/components/color-picker/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/color-picker/meta.json

## Combobox (combobox)
Type to filter a list and pick one option.
Import: import {Combobox} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- ARIA 1.2 combobox: the input has role="combobox" with aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant.
- ArrowDown/ArrowUp move through options, Enter picks, Escape closes (and clears the typed text on a second press), Tab leaves.
- Options are in a listbox with aria-selected; an empty result is announced as text.
Files: packages/react/src/components/combobox/combobox.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/combobox/combobox.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/combobox/combobox.tsx, packages/react/src/components/combobox/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/combobox/meta.json

## Command (command)
A searchable palette of actions that opens over the page, with an optional global shortcut.
Import: import {Command} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Dialog | Status: stable
A11y:
- A modal dialog named by a hidden title; focus moves to the search input and returns to the opener on close.
- The input is an ARIA combobox controlling a listbox of grouped options; focus stays in the input and aria-activedescendant names the active option.
- ArrowUp and ArrowDown move (skipping disabled items), Home and End jump, Enter runs the item, Escape closes.
- The shortcut prop toggles the palette from anywhere (mod is Cmd on Mac, Ctrl elsewhere); result count is announced through a status region.
Files: packages/react/src/components/command/command.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/command/command.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/command/command.tsx, packages/react/src/components/command/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/command/meta.json

## Confetti (confetti)
A short burst of square confetti on a canvas, triggered by a prop or a ref method.
Import: import {Confetti} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- The canvas is aria-hidden and ignores the pointer, so it never blocks or announces anything.
- Off under prefers-reduced-motion: no burst is drawn. Announce the event it celebrates in text as well.
Files: packages/react/src/components/confetti/confetti.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/confetti/confetti.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/confetti/confetti.tsx, packages/react/src/components/confetti/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/confetti/meta.json

- A plain div; adds no roles.

## Context menu (context-menu)
A menu of actions opened by right click or long press on an area.
Import: import {ContextMenu} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/ContextMenu | Status: stable
A11y:
- Opens with right click, long press or the context-menu key (Shift+F10).
- Arrow keys move, Enter or Space selects, Escape closes and returns focus.
- Every action must also exist elsewhere in the UI for people who cannot open it.
Files: packages/react/src/components/context-menu/context-menu.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/context-menu/context-menu.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/context-menu/context-menu.tsx, packages/react/src/components/context-menu/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/context-menu/meta.json

## Data table (data-table)
A table with sortable columns, row selection and pagination.
Import: import {DataTable} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- Native table; sortable headers hold a real button and the th carries aria-sort (ascending, descending, none).
- Each row and the select-all box are checkboxes with names; select-all shows the indeterminate state for a partial selection.
- The count of selected rows is announced through a status region.
- An empty result shows an empty state inside the table; pagination is a nav landmark of buttons.
Files: packages/react/src/components/data-table/data-table.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/data-table/data-table.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/data-table/data-table.tsx, packages/react/src/components/data-table/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/data-table/meta.json

## Date picker (date-picker)
A button that opens a calendar and shows the chosen date.
Import: import {DatePicker} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Popover | Status: stable
A11y:
- The trigger is a button naming the field and the current value; it opens a dialog with the calendar.
- Choosing a date closes the dialog and returns focus to the trigger; Escape closes without changing.
- All calendar keyboard behaviour applies inside.

- The sweep is a pseudo-element, never read aloud, and is off under prefers-reduced-motion.

## Tree (tree)
A nested list of items that open and close, with one selected item.
Import: import {Tree} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- role=tree with treeitem children and role=group for branches; aria-expanded on branches, aria-selected on every item, aria-level on each.
- Roving tabindex: one item is in the tab order; Tab enters and leaves the tree as one stop.
- ArrowUp/ArrowDown move, ArrowRight opens a branch then enters it, ArrowLeft closes it then goes to the parent, Home and End jump.
- Enter or Space selects; typing letters jumps to the next label that starts with them. The tree needs an aria-label.

Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- No DOM output. Pair the copied state with a visible or aria-live status message in the UI.
- A failed copy returns false and sets error; it never throws.

Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- No DOM output. Lets a custom widget accept value/defaultValue/onValueChange like the Monoline components do.
- onChange fires only when the new value differs from the current one.

## useFocusTrap (use-focus-trap)

Import: import {UseFocusTrap} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- Tab and Shift+Tab cycle inside the container while active. Focus moves in on activation.
- Focus returns to the element that had it before when the trap ends. Escape to close is the caller's job.

Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- No DOM output. Shortcuts are additions: every control must still be reachable by keyboard and Tab.
- mod means Cmd on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere. Typing in inputs is ignored unless allowInInputs is set.

- No DOM output. Clears its timer on unmount so nothing runs after the component is gone.
- Pass null as the delay to pause.
